ordered_parameters.name: input
ordered_parameters.type: contiguous Tensor<f32> with trailing dimension two

semantics.mutation_rule: read-only view construction with no storage mutation
semantics.alias_rule: shares the exact source storage through Tensor::reinterpret_contiguous_read_only and cannot acquire a writable lease
semantics.shape_rule: removes the final dimension, which must equal two; scalar and other trailing sizes fail typed
semantics.dtype_rule: certified contiguous f32 input reinterprets as complex64 with exactly equal byte length
semantics.layout_rule: source and target must be zero-offset canonical contiguous descriptors
semantics.device_rule: CPU ordinal zero is certified and device plus stream identity are preserved
semantics.numeric_rule: each adjacent f32 pair is interpreted as real then imaginary without copying or conversion
semantics.determinism: immutable descriptor validation and storage aliasing
semantics.cancellation_points: before validation and after checked view construction
semantics.vjp_rule: a complex gradient maps each element back to its adjacent real and imaginary f32 pair
semantics.jvp_rule: an adjacent f32 tangent pair is reinterpreted through the identical checked view geometry
